name: Thornroot Hollow
_design: Fight arena, dusk (Boss 2026-10-14: 27 x 21 m, ~1.7x the first version). A round hollow ringed by giant thorny red roots; one huge root arches over the north edge and frames a goblin shrine (totem with skull stakes) between the two exit portals, a second arch spans the west rim - two landmarks that also say 'the way out is north'. Inside, six cover pieces ring an open middle: moss rocks south-west and east, two broken stumps gripped by red roots (east and west), and the thornroot well - a woven basket of roots round a cold-glowing pool, the only cool light in the field and the one piece of cover worth fighting around. The player starts south-centre; melee spots are near, the ranged ones last on the west and east flanks, so a mixed fight pulls the player sideways across the wide floor instead of straight north. Built by tools/blender/build_goblin_stages.py (art and this file come from one layout; edit the script, not this file).
